name: mordred-burnished-avenger-levelup-enter-top-card-not-attack
notes: Mordred, Burnished Avenger (OWCdWq3mXY): "If it's an attack card, you may banish it." The top card of the deck is a Dungeon Guide (an ally): the real level-up reveals it but no banish prompt appears, nothing is banished and the card is simply drawn in the draw step.

rulesClauses: If it's an attack card, you may banish it (a non-attack top card has no effect).
